explanation: The execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 receives evidence_sources whose record_id values are source ids (s01...s08), while needs/coverage use demand record ids (n06-r01...n06-r08). Job 2 then cannot match provenance ranks to coverage records, producing upstream_rank 0 for every priority. The supplied upstream source localizes the cause to assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the need record_id.
cited_evidence: Behavioral criteria require preserving deterministic source provenance identities, weights, and demand-descending rank order, and preserving exact upstream-to-downstream handoffs.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains entries such as {"rank":1,"record_id":"s01","source_id":"s01"} while Job 2 input needs contains {"record_id":"n06-r01","source_id":"s01"}.
Observed Job 2 priorities show every item has "upstream_rank":0 despite evidence_sources containing ranks 1 through 8.
assemble_provenance source: records.append({"record_id": record.get('source_id', ""), "source_id": record.get("source_id", ""), "source_weight": record.get("source_weight", 0), "rank": index})
